notes: Read all 170 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the default-exported OnboardingWizard component, both state names (visible default false, currentStep default 0), the ONBOARDED_KEY ('teslasync-onboarded') constant, the 1500ms settle delay, the OnboardingStep interface, the four-entry steps table (titles/descriptions/colors verbatim, em dash and apostrophe intact), and the handleClose / handleNext control flow (advance while currentStep < steps.length-1 else close; close writes the flag, hides, and broadcasts).

Source lines 6/51/68 localStorage get/set of ONBOARDED_KEY became readOnboarded/writeOnboarded that prefer globalThis.localStorage when present (react-native-web target, same key) and fall back to an in-process flag; durable cross-restart persistence on a pure native runtime is intentionally unavailable (nativeOnboardingCapabilities.durableOnboardedPersistenceAvailable=false).

Source lines 4/61-65/70 @/lib/broadcast subscribe+broadcast of { type: 'onboarded' } became a module listener set: broadcastOnboarded() replaces broadcast({type:'onboarded'}) on close, and the second effect subscribes via subscribeOnboarded to setVisible(false) when another surface completes onboarding; cross-tab/cross-device fan-out is web-only and marked unavailable (crossTabBroadcastAvailable=false).

Source lines 1/47-57/61-65 hooks (useState/useEffect) and the two effects (mount localStorage probe with setTimeout/clearTimeout cleanup; subscribe with unsubscribe cleanup) ported faithfully to React Native useState/useEffect with the same timer cleanup and unsubscribe return.

Source lines 87-90/102-108 fixed inset-0 overlay + click-dismiss backdrop + onKeyDown Escape became a React Native Modal (transparent, animationType fade, visible={visible}, onRequestClose=handleClose for hardware back) with a dimmed centered overlay View and an absolute-fill backdrop Pressable (onPress=handleClose). The web `if (!visible) return null` (line 81) is expressed as Modal visible={visible}; backdrop-blur-sm and the top-12 lg:top-0 mobile-header inset have no native analog and are dropped (documented).

Source line 2 lucide-react icons became monochrome BMP glyph markers preserving visual intent: Zap -> '\u26a1' (welcome), Car -> '\u26df' (vehicle, line 27), Settings -> '\u2699' (gear, line 35), CheckCircle -> '\u2713' (line 41), X close -> '\u00d7' (line 107), ChevronRight -> '\u203a' (line 159, rendered only on non-final steps).

Source lines 93-164 markup (div/button/h2/p + Tailwind/CSS-var/inline styles) became React Native View/Pressable/AppText with a StyleSheet and native tokens: step indicators keep the i<=currentStep cyan (COLOR.CYAN -> CYAN '#00f0ff') vs rgba(255,255,255,0.1) fill and the 24px-active/8px-inactive width; the icon chip keeps the `${step.color}15` translucent background and `step.color` glyph; the Next button's CSS linear-gradient(#00f0ff20,#8b5cf620)+border becomes a flat rgba(0,240,255,0.12) fill with rgba(0,240,255,0.2) border (documented); Skip/Next labels and 'Get Started' text are verbatim. No DOM elements, lucide, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported.

i18n intent preserved: the web component uses no react-i18next layer (its strings are hardcoded English), so every title/description plus 'Skip', 'Next', and 'Get Started' is ported verbatim with no behavioral change.
